userGoal: Finish the remaining repair-jammer combat behavior: every healing source is blocked, the duration is upgrade-driven at 2→3→4 target turns, and simulation state is observable for the no-repair-2 presentation.
inScope: Direct defensive healing and existing timed repair regeneration respect the active jammer.
The status duration is derived from the firing weapon evolution and expires after the configured number of completed target turns.
BattleSimulation provides a public read-only query that presentation can use per affected unit.
outOfScope: Importing or wiring the no-repair-2 art into a scene prefab.
Unimplemented future healing systems with no runtime seam in the repository.
completionCriteria: A jammed target gains no timed regeneration while jammed, then resumes when the status expires.
A profile configured for two jammer duration upgrades blocks healing for four completed target turns.
A public state query reports active then inactive status at the observed lifecycle boundary.
